key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7C66
name: store_long_through_pointer
description: Writes a 32-bit value from a data register through an address register pointer and returns zero. It has no library calls and is reached from four unnamed routines.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7C70
name: close_file_and_zero_block
description: Closes the file handle held in the structure through the dos library when the handle is non-zero, otherwise repeats the check on the global state block. It then clears 144 bytes starting at the structure, and the surrounding text reports a closing error for an already closed handle.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7C88
name: close_file_zero_block_direct
description: Closes the file handle through the dos library's Close entry, then clears 144 bytes starting at the structure. It is called by one unnamed routine and has no branch for an empty handle.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7CAA
name: read_when_count_positive
description: Returns zero without reading when the requested byte count is not positive. Otherwise it calls the dos library's Read entry with the caller's arguments and returns that result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7D28
name: forward_dos_write
description: Calls the dos library's Write entry through the library base, passing the caller's arguments on, and returns nothing. It is called from one unnamed routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:7FB0
name: store_standard_handles
description: Stores the result of the dos Input call in the state block. It also stores the result of the dos Output call there, unless a state flag is set, in which case it stores zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:809E
name: call_dos_792_if_clear
description: Calls a dos library entry at offset -792 only when a state byte is zero. It is entered through a handler pointer and from one unnamed routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:80C0
name: cleanup_after_user_abort
description: Calls two helper routines in turn, the second one with the global state block. The text "User aborted" appears among the referenced strings of the surrounding archive code, which points to an abort path.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:80D0
name: apply_mode_five_set_flag
description: When a state byte is zero, calls a helper with the global block and the value 5, then sets a companion flag byte to one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:80EC
name: apply_mode_four_clear_flag
description: When a state byte is zero, calls a helper with the global block and the value 4, then sets a companion flag byte to zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8106
name: write_when_output_enabled
description: Calls the dos Write entry only when a state flag is clear and the stored output handle is non-zero. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8134
name: write_output_in_blocks
description: Writes the requested count to the output handle in pieces of at most 1024 bytes. It checks a helper between pieces and returns 11 if that helper reports an error, otherwise it returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8158
name: write_remaining_in_chunks
description: Writes the remaining byte count through the dos Write entry in pieces of at most 1024 bytes. A checking helper runs between pieces, and an error from it makes the routine return 11.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8164
name: write_chunks_until_exhausted
description: Writes data in pieces of at most 1024 bytes until no bytes remain, returning zero on completion. A helper runs between pieces, and an error from it makes the routine return 11.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:818C
name: format_string_and_write
description: When output is enabled and the output handle is set, formats a line into a buffer in the state block, measures its length by scanning to the terminator, then writes it with the dos Write entry.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:81D0
name: call_dos_426_if_clear
description: Calls the dos library entry at offset -426 only when a state byte is zero. The routine is entered from one unnamed caller.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:81EE
name: call_dos_426_copy
description: Calls the dos library entry at offset -426 only when a state byte is zero. It is a second copy of the same gated call, reached from one unnamed caller.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:820C
name: read_byte_with_state_wrappers
description: Reads one value through the dos Read entry, with helper calls before and after it. Extra helper calls run when a state byte is set, and it is entered from three unnamed routines.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8250
name: read_char_matching_set
description: Reads characters through a helper, folds lowercase to uppercase using a character class table in the state block, and echoes each one through a formatting helper. It returns the first character that appears in the supplied zero-terminated set.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8296
name: scan_input_for_match
description: Reads characters through a helper, folds lowercase to uppercase using the class table, and checks each against the characters of a buffer. It keeps looping until one of them matches, then returns that character.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:82B2
name: scan_input_after_step
description: Advances the buffer pointer, then reads characters through a helper, folding lowercase to uppercase with the class table and echoing each one through a formatting helper. It loops until a character equals the value held in the caller's register.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:82B6
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; it is an empty entry reached from one unnamed routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:82BC
name: run_three_step_cleanup
description: Calls the global-state helper, then a second helper, then the global-state helper again, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:82D4
name: open_library_compute_unit_size
description: Opens a library by name through the exec base, reads a window measurement between a Forbid and Permit pair, and divides it by a per-unit size from the structure. The quotient is clamped to at least 8, the routine returns 23 when a lookup fails, and it closes the library before returning.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:838C
name: check_string_against_stacked_set
description: Copies an 8-byte table from the global block onto the stack, then returns 1 as soon as a character of the string matches one of its entries, or 0 at the terminator. The referenced text lists the same eight punctuation characters.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:83C2
name: check_string_cyclic_stacked_set
description: Walks the string testing each character against the eight stacked entries by index, returning 1 on a match and 0 at the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:83C6
name: check_string_stacked_set_ahead
description: Advances to the next character before each test against the eight stacked entries; it returns 1 on a match and 0 when the terminator is reached.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:83CA
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero and does nothing else; a data pointer and one unnamed routine reach it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8AC2
name: release_memory_block
description: Calls the exec FreeMem entry through the library base with the caller's arguments and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8AE0
name: try_allocate_halving_sizes
description: Repeatedly halves a stored count and asks the allocation helper for memory at each size, returning zero on the first success. When no size succeeds down to the limit, it calls a cleanup helper and returns one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8B00
name: retry_allocation_halving_size
description: Halves a size count and calls the allocation helper at each size, returning zero on the first success. When the size reaches the limit it runs the cleanup helper and returns one, and the surrounding text reports a fatal memory error.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8B24
name: forward_pair_to_helper
description: Passes its two arguments unchanged to a helper and returns nothing. A data pointer references it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8B40
name: consume_bits_refill_word
description: Discards a number of bits from the bit buffer and, when the bit counter runs out, refills the buffer with a 16-bit word from the input stream.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8BCA
name: read_masked_bits_then_consume
description: Takes the current bit buffer value, consumes the requested number of bits, and returns the low bits selected by a mask of that width.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8BF8
name: decode_symbol_eight_bit_table
description: Decodes one symbol using an eight-bit lookup table, walking a binary tree bit by bit when the entry is a link. It then consumes the symbol's code length from the bit buffer and returns the symbol.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8C56
name: decode_symbol_six_bit_table
description: Decodes one symbol using a six-bit lookup table, walking a binary tree bit by bit when the entry is a link. It consumes the code length from a length table and returns the symbol.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8CB0
name: refill_bit_buffer_words
description: Reads two 16-bit words from the input stream, advances the stream pointer, loads them into the bit buffer, and sets the bit count to sixteen.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8CFE
name: fill_256_decoded_values
description: Calls a decoding helper 256 times and stores each returned value in turn into a 256-byte destination buffer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8D2E
name: read_bytes_and_sum
description: Reads values through a helper into the destination while the counter is not negative, and returns the running sum truncated to 16 bits.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8D60
name: read_lzx_block_header
description: Reads an LZX block header from the bit stream, including table sizes and fixed fields, then allocates the decoding tables through the allocator helper. When the verify flag is set it compares a byte sum with a stored 16-bit value and refuses to continue on a mismatch; the surrounding text reports insufficient memory.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8F3A
name: count_newline_characters
description: Walks a zero-terminated string and returns how many newline characters it contains. It has one unnamed caller.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8F5C
name: call_helper_with_flag_one
description: Calls a helper with the value one and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8F68
name: write_wrapped_lines
description: Walks a text buffer line by line, writing each line through a helper and wrapping long lines to a width computed from a stored column value. It stops and reports an error when a checking helper returns a non-zero result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:8FF0
name: combine_four_values_base16
description: Combines four bytes read from a pointer into one 16-bit number by multiplying the running total by sixteen before each addition.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:9016
name: stub_no_op_entry
description: Does nothing and returns; one unnamed routine calls it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:901E
name: init_once_with_zero_arg
description: On the first call sets a state byte to one and calls a helper with zero; later calls see the byte set and do nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:9084
name: compare_path_leaf_names
description: Strips the directory part from two path strings by finding their last slash or colon, then compares the remaining names through a helper. It returns one when the helper reports a match and zero otherwise, including when a path is empty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:90BC
name: test_path_leaf_with_helper
description: Finds the final separator in a path and passes the name after it to a helper. It returns one when the helper returns zero and zero when the path is empty.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:90E8
name: is_helper_result_zero
description: Calls a helper and returns true only when its result is zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:90FA
name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns the constant zero; three unnamed routines reach it through data pointers and calls.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:9102
name: test_path_ends_with_slash
description: Returns one when the last character of a string is a forward slash, and zero otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:9126
name: return_zero_gap_fill
description: Returns zero. The code sits in a gap between routines and is called from one unnamed routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:9250
name: normalize_path_separators
description: Replaces every backslash in a string with a forward slash, in place, up to the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:926E
name: stub_empty_return_two
description: Does nothing and returns, and one unnamed routine calls it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:9274
name: split_amiga_path_parts
description: Splits an Amiga path into its device, directory and file parts at the last slash and colon, copying each piece into an optional output buffer. The output buffers are cleared first.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:92CA
name: copy_path_tail_parts
description: Copies the portion of a path after the last separator into an output buffer, or the whole path when no separator exists. It also terminates the directory and device strings at the separator position.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:92E2
name: copy_path_remainder_parts
description: Copies the remainder of a path after a separator into an output buffer, then writes terminators into the directory and device buffers at the separator position.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:9312
name: terminate_path_pieces
description: Writes terminators into output buffers at positions computed from the separator index, and writes a device terminator when a colon follows the directory.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:933E
name: terminate_device_directory_parts
description: Writes a terminator into the directory buffer after the separator, and into the device buffer when a colon is found at the separator position.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:9400
name: find_matching_list_node
description: Walks a linked list and returns the first node whose name matches the given name under mode flags. Flags choose plain comparison or a comparison on normalized names held in stack buffers, and when a flag bit is set an extra library call checks each node name before it is accepted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:9424
name: find_list_node_flag_test
description: Walks a linked list of named nodes and returns the first node that matches, using a mode flag to choose comparison on normalized names held in stack buffers. When a flag bit is set, an extra library call checks each node name before it is accepted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:942E
name: find_list_node_by_name
description: Walks the linked list and returns the first node whose name satisfies a comparison helper. When a flag is set, a library check on each node name must also pass.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:94A6
name: find_next_list_match
description: Walks forward through a linked list from the given node and returns the first node whose name check passes. Two flag bytes select normalized comparison and an extra library check.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:94BC
name: find_list_node_library_check
description: Makes two library calls at fixed negative offsets before walking the list for the first node that passes the name comparison. It returns null when the list ends without a match.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:94EA
name: find_list_node_or_zero
description: Walks the linked list from the given node and returns the first node that passes the library-backed or name-based check. It returns zero when the list ends.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:94F2
name: return_zero_list_stub
description: Returns zero; three unnamed routines reach it through data pointers and calls.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:9590
name: append_named_list_node
description: Appends a new node holding a copy of the name to a linked list, rejecting duplicates when a flag is set by checking each existing name first. It writes a status of 1 for allocation failure or 2 for a duplicate and returns the new node or zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:95D4
name: append_named_node_skip_dup
description: Allocates a node sized for the name, copies the name into it, and appends it to the list without a duplicate check. It writes a status of 1 when allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:95DE
name: allocate_and_append_named_node
description: Allocates a node sized for the name, clears its header, copies the name into it, sets its flag, and appends it to the list tail. It writes a status of 1 when allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:9606
name: initialize_and_append_node
description: Clears a preallocated node header, copies the name into it, sets its flag, and links it at the list tail. It reports success through a status pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:963A
name: link_node_after_tail_checked
description: Links a node after the list's tail pointer and sets the status to zero. When the tail pointer is missing it reports an internal list error and sets the status to one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:966C
name: link_node_to_tail_unchecked
description: Links a node after the list's tail pointer and sets the status to zero, without checking that a tail exists.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B2A0
name: open_output_or_report_error
description: Calls an open helper for the output file named in the state block. When that helper reports an error, it prints the "can't open for output" message with the file name and returns true.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B324
name: close_output_if_open
description: Closes the output file held in the state block when its handle field is set.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B524
name: allocate_all_work_buffers
description: Allocates the work buffers in sequence: two of 131072 bytes, two of 32768 bytes, one of 4096 bytes, a 768-entry table, and two buffers sized from state fields. A cleanup helper runs and the routine returns one when any allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B544
name: allocate_buffers_from_first_big
description: Allocates the work-buffer sequence from the first 131072-byte buffer onward, with the same cleanup and failure return.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B560
name: allocate_buffers_from_second_big
description: Allocates the work-buffer sequence from the second 131072-byte buffer onward, returning one on any failed allocation.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B57C
name: allocate_buffers_from_size_field
description: Allocates the work-buffer sequence from the buffer sized by a state field onward, returning one on any failed allocation.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B59E
name: allocate_buffers_from_first_small
description: Allocates the work-buffer sequence from the first 32768-byte buffer onward, then sets a state flag on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B5BE
name: allocate_buffers_from_second_small
description: Allocates the final buffers from the second 32768-byte buffer onward, then sets a state flag on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B5D8
name: allocate_buffers_from_4k
description: Allocates the 4096-byte work buffer and the 768-entry table, then sets two output pointers and a state flag on success. A cleanup helper runs when either allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B5F0
name: allocate_table_and_set_pointers
description: Allocates the 768-entry table and, on success, sets two pointers and a state flag. It runs a cleanup helper and returns true when the allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B60A
name: set_buffer_pointers_after_allocation
description: Sets two pointers to the first two allocated buffers, each offset by 65536 bytes, sets a state flag, and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B638
name: release_all_work_buffers
description: Frees each work buffer whose pointer is set, using the matching size, clears its pointer, and clears the state flag. The sizes match those used by the allocation routines.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B762
name: release_secondary_buffer
description: Frees a buffer whose size is held in a state field, then clears its pointer when it was set.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B77A
name: flush_pending_output
description: When the write position is behind the flush position, writes the pending bytes through a helper and reports error code 7 on failure. It then moves the flush position up to the write position.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B89E
name: write_bytes_with_counter
description: Writes a block of bytes through a buffered helper and adds the count to a running total on success. It returns 2 when the helper writes fewer bytes than requested, and returns 1 early when an enabling byte is zero and a helper reports a condition.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B8A4
name: flush_buffer_once
description: Calls a helper with the buffer held in the state block and the value one, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B8B4
name: allocate_table_block
description: Allocates a block of 7728 bytes and, on success, sets two pointers offset by 1548 and 4638 bytes. It returns true when the allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B8CA
name: set_table_pointers_from_block
description: Sets two pointers into an already allocated 7728-byte block, using offsets of 1548 and 4638 bytes, and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:B8E6
name: release_table_block
description: Frees the 7728-byte block when its pointer is set, then clears the pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:BCAC
name: fill_code_length_table
description: Once per state, fills the first 512 bytes of a table in the state block with increasing code values written in runs whose lengths double.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:BCF4
name: fill_remaining_table_upper_half
description: Continues the table fill with doubling runs of code values, each run one higher than the last, and stops when the index passes 511.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:BD14
name: fill_table_alternating_runs
description: Fills the table with doubling runs that alternate between a base code and the code one higher, stopping once 512 entries are written.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:C596
name: allocate_four_pointer_table
description: Allocates a table sized from a count, zeroes it, and stores four pointers into it at offsets derived from that count. It returns one when the allocation fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:C5BC
name: zero_four_pointer_table
description: Zeroes a table sized from a count and stores four pointers into it at offsets derived from that count, then returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:C5C8
name: fill_region_and_set_pointers
description: Fills a region with a constant byte, then stores four pointers into the table at offsets derived from a count, and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:C606
name: free_four_pointer_table
description: Frees the table sized from a count when its first pointer is set, then clears all four pointers.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:C874
name: format_text_into_buffer
description: Calls the exec RawDoFmt routine through the library base with the caller's arguments and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:C898
name: format_text_stream_variant
description: Calls the exec RawDoFmt routine with the caller's arguments and a character-copy routine as its output writer, then returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:D544
name: update_checksum_block
description: Updates a running 32-bit checksum over a block of bytes using a 256-entry lookup table in the state block, keeps the running value between calls, and returns its complement.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:D63E
name: update_checksum_in_megabyte_steps
description: Resets the running checksum to all ones when the buffer pointer is null and returns zero. Otherwise it passes the data to the checksum helper in pieces of 1048576 bytes and returns the helper's result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:D65A
name: process_in_megabyte_steps
description: Calls a helper once for each 1048576-byte piece of a count and then once for any remainder, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:D66C
name: process_megabyte_steps_remainder
description: Calls a helper once per 1048576-byte piece of a count, then for the remaining bytes, returning when the count reaches zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E420
name: build_canonical_decode_table
description: Counts how often each code length occurs, accumulates the starting code for each length, and fills the decoding table for the symbols. The pseudo-code is cut off after the table fill begins, so the rest of the fill is not visible.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E6C0
name: run_handler_list_until_null
description: Walks a null-terminated list of handler pointers stored in the state block, calls each handler, and keeps the last result. It sets a state flag when the list is finished.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E6C6
name: run_handler_list_do_while
description: Calls handlers from a null-terminated pointer list, keeping the last result, and sets a state flag once the list has been walked.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E6F4
name: call_indirect_handler_return_constant
description: Calls a handler through a pointer held in a global variable, passing the address of a global variable, and returns the constant 20.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E716
name: invoke_global_callback
description: Calls a function pointer held in a global variable, passing the address of another global variable, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E7D8
name: compare_strings_ignoring_case
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings one character at a time, converting lowercase letters to uppercase first. It returns the difference at the first mismatch, or zero when the strings match.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E81C
name: parse_signed_decimal_integer
description: Reads an optional plus or minus sign and then decimal digits from a string, stores the signed value through a pointer, and returns the offset of the first character after the digits.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E868
name: lowercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each uppercase letter of a zero-terminated string to lowercase in place, using the character class table in the state block, and returns the same pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E874
name: lowercase_string_loop
description: Lowercases a zero-terminated string in place using the character class table and stops at the terminator; it returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E88E
name: write_seed_and_lowercase_copy
description: Writes a seed character into a string, then copies each following character, converting uppercase letters to lowercase, until the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E8A0
name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each lowercase letter of a zero-terminated string to uppercase in place, using the character class table, and returns the same pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E8AC
name: uppercase_string_loop
description: Uppercases each letter of a zero-terminated string in place using the character class table, stopping at the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E8C6
name: write_seed_and_uppercase_copy
description: Writes a seed character into a string, then copies each following character, converting lowercase letters to uppercase, until the terminator.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E8D8
name: free_pending_node_list
description: Pops nodes from a linked list held in the state block and frees each one through the exec FreeMem routine. When the list ends and the exec library version is above 35, it makes one extra exec call.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E8DE
name: free_node_list_do_while
description: Frees each node of a linked list in the state block through the exec FreeMem routine, with the same extra exec call when the library version is above 35.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E948
name: run_frame_cleanup_sequence
description: Saves the given value in a stack frame, calls a stored callback when one is set, then runs several exec library calls, including a library close and a memory free. It returns the saved frame value as a 64-bit result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:E950
name: split_command_line_arguments
description: Splits a command line into words, where a quoted string counts as one word and an asterisk escapes the next character: E gives an escape character and N a newline. It counts the words, allocates a pointer array through the memory allocator, and stores the start of each word in it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EAB4
name: free_argument_array
description: Frees the argument pointer array through the exec memory release routine when it was allocated, and returns the argument count.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EAD8
name: compare_bounded_strings
description: Compares up to a set number of bytes of two strings and returns minus one when the first differing byte is smaller or the strings end, one when it is larger, and zero when the compared bytes are equal.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EAFC
name: derive_comparison_sign
description: Converts the processor flags from a preceding comparison into minus one when the first value is less than or equal to the second, and one otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EB08
name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Finds the terminator of the destination string, copies the source string after it, and returns the destination pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EB20
name: copy_bounded_string_padded
description: Copies up to a given count of bytes from a source string into a destination, stopping at the source terminator and zero-filling the rest, then returns the destination pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EB30
name: copy_bounded_string_loop
description: Copies a source string into a destination of fixed length, stopping at the source terminator and zero-filling the remainder. It returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EB3A
name: zero_fill_buffer
description: Writes zero bytes across a region, one more byte than the given count.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EB44
name: test_first_char_class_bit
description: Tests the first character of a string against a class-flag bit in the state block table and calls a helper when that bit is clear. It returns the value the helper leaves, and a null pointer returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EB78
name: run_handler_records_with_value
description: Walks a linked list of handler records in the state block, calls the handler stored in each record, then calls a helper with the given value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EB7C
name: run_handler_records_then_finish
description: Walks the same handler record list, calling each handler, and then calls a helper without an argument.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EBC6
name: restore_saved_context_frame
description: Restores a saved register set onto a task stack. When a pending-node list exists it frees each node through exec routines, and the returned pair holds the saved size and value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:C/LZX:0:EC50
name: forward_call_only
description: Calls one helper and returns, with no other work.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:Libs/Arp.library:0:0236
name: init_arp_pointer_list
description: Part of Arp.library: stores a record reference, fills a pointer array through repeated library lookups, and on success links the record and runs a library finishing call. Otherwise it leaves through the library error exit.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:Libs/Arp.library:0:0266
name: fill_arp_pointer_list_loop
description: Part of Arp.library: continues filling the pointer array from the lookup results, then links the record and runs the finishing sequence, leaving through the error exit when a lookup fails.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:Libs/Arp.library:0:029E
name: finish_arp_record_setup
description: Part of Arp.library: stores a record pointer, calls several library routines including an allocation, keeps the allocated pointer and a flag in the record, and completes with a further library call. A null allocation leaves through the error exit.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:Libs/Arp.library:0:02F0
name: repeat_arp_call_until_flag
description: Part of Arp.library: repeats a library call together with a helper until the call's flag clears, then increments a counter field in the library base.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:Libs/Arp.library:0:0302
name: clear_arp_field_and_call
description: Part of Arp.library: clears a field of the given structure and calls a library routine through the library base.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:Libs/Arp.library:0:046E
name: allocate_arp_size_block
description: Part of Arp.library: when a size is non-zero, allocates memory through the exec allocator and writes the size plus four into the first word of the block.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:0000
name: start_lzx_program
description: Program entry point for the LZX program: it allocates a working block, copies in its initial data with pointer adjustments, and takes the current directory and start message. It builds an argument string when started from the command line, calls the main routine, and releases resources before exiting.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:020C
name: finish_task_and_reply
description: Stores the return value on the task stack, calls an optional callback, and unlocks a directory lock or replies to the start message depending on a flag. It then closes the library, frees the memory block, and returns the saved value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:02A8
name: invoke_secondary_callback
description: Calls a function pointer held in a global variable, passing the address of a global variable, and returns nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:02AE
name: call_secondary_handler_constant
description: Calls a function pointer held in a global variable with the address of a global variable as argument, and returns the constant 20.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:02B4
name: split_command_line_words
description: Repeats the command-line word splitting used at program start: it counts the words, allocates a pointer array, and fills it, honoring quotes and asterisk escapes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:02BC
name: lookup_or_set_state_flag
description: Calls a lookup helper on a state buffer. When the helper reports no result it sets a state flag and returns false; otherwise it calls two helpers and returns true.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:02FA
name: set_state_flag_return_zero
description: Sets a state flag byte to one and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:0818
name: write_block_counted_total
description: Writes a block of the given length through a helper and adds the length to a running total on success. It returns 1 when an enabling byte is clear and a helper reports a condition, and 2 when the write is short.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:0836
name: flush_counted_write
description: Calls a helper with the state buffer and the length in a data register, adds that length to the running total when the helper returns the same number, and returns 2 otherwise.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:084E
name: add_count_to_total
description: Adds the value in a data register to the running total in the state block and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:142E
name: free_list_nodes_and_clear
description: Walks a linked list held in the state block, releasing each node through a helper with a size argument of 118, then clears the head and tail pointers and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:144C
name: clear_list_head_tail
description: Clears the head and tail pointers of a list held in the state block.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:162C
name: pack_option_flags_byte
description: Packs eight state flags into the bits of one byte, writing one bit per flag into the byte at the given pointer.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:51C8
name: parse_lzx_options
description: Parses the command-line options by reading each option letter through the argument scanner. Letter options set state flags, digit options store preset values, and the letters C, E and F read a value through a helper; an unknown option returns one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5B7C
name: fetch_next_option_argument
description: Scans the argument vector for the next option and returns a pointer to the text after its letter, or zero when no arguments remain. It stores the option letter in a byte and notes dash-prefixed options.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5B82
name: fetch_next_option_copy
description: A second copy of the argument scanner, returning the option text after its letter and storing the letter in a byte.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5C24
name: fetch_next_file_argument
description: Returns the next argument string from the vector, skipping dash-marked entries unless a flag allows them, and returns zero when the list is exhausted.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5C8E
name: parse_date_year_month_day
description: Parses a date written as year, month and day separated by slashes. The year must be from 1970 to 2099, the month from 1 to 12 and the day from 1 to 31, and the parts are stored in a three-byte record; it returns zero on success and one when any part is invalid.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5CBA
name: parse_date_fields_with_base
description: Stores a leading base byte in a record, then parses the month and day of a date string, requiring the month from 1 to 12 and the day from 1 to 31. It returns one on error.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5CD2
name: parse_month_day_pair
description: Parses a month and a day separated by a slash, requiring the month from 1 to 12 and the day from 1 to 31, and stores both in a record. It returns one on error.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5CE4
name: parse_month_then_day
description: Parses the month value into a record byte, skips the separator, then parses the day from 1 to 31 into the next byte. It returns one on any invalid value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5D00
name: parse_day_after_slash
description: Skips to the character after the next slash, parses a day value from 1 to 31 into a record byte, and returns one when the value is invalid.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5D0E
name: parse_day_field
description: Skips an optional leading slash, parses a day value from 1 to 31 into a record byte, and returns one when the value is invalid.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5D20
name: store_and_check_day
description: Stores a parsed value in the record and returns one unless the value is between 1 and 31.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5D3C
name: return_zero_gap_stub
description: Returns zero; five unnamed routines call it.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5D44
name: initialize_default_settings
description: Sets the default option flags and buffer size values in the state block, copies a constant name string into a state field, and selects a size from a mode byte.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5E10
name: handle_pause_and_priority
description: Adjusts the task priority through the exec library when a flag is set, and updates pause-related flags. When a pause is requested it calls the pause helper, which shows the paused prompt, and returns a status character.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5E8C
name: test_leading_char_class_bit
description: Skips characters of a string whose class-flag bit is set, then calls a helper and returns the value it leaves. A null pointer returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5E92
name: run_handler_records_and_forward
description: Walks the handler record list in the state block, calling each record's handler, and then calls a helper with the given value.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5E98
name: setup_callbacks_and_run
description: Clears three state fields through helpers, installs a global callback pointer, and runs a helper with the two parameters. It calls a finishing helper when that result is one, and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:5FEC
name: detect_arp_and_mode
description: Reads the exec library version: below 37 it opens the Arp library and sets a flag, otherwise it sets a bit in the task flags. It then derives a mode value from three flag bits of a structure and clears two state bytes.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:607A
name: forward_call_again
description: Calls one helper and returns with no other work.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:6080
name: save_and_clear_pointer_field
description: Saves a pointer field of an object in the state block, sets that field to minus one, and sets a flag byte.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:70A8
name: format_temp_file_name
description: Builds a temporary file name by formatting the base name with a temporary-file suffix and a numeric index scaled by 92 bytes, then calls a helper with the result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7B74
name: map_open_mode_name_code
description: Compares a file open-mode name with three constant names and returns one of three numeric codes, 1005, 1004 or 1006, for the match found.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7BAC
name: open_file_by_mode_name
description: Maps an open-mode string to a numeric code. For the code 1004 with no Arp flag, it locks and opens the file through the dos library, stores the handle, and returns zero on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7BC6
name: open_file_mode_or_lock
description: Maps an open-mode string to one of two numeric codes, then opens the file through the dos library, locking first for one of the codes, and stores the handle on success.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7BE0
name: open_file_by_mode_short
description: Checks the open-mode string against two constant names and otherwise reports an error through a helper. For a matching code it opens the file through the dos library and stores the handle.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7BFA
name: report_unknown_open_mode
description: Reports an unrecognized file open mode by calling a helper with the message and error code 40. When no Arp flag is set it opens the file through the dos library, storing the handle or returning one on failure.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7C34
name: store_handle_or_unlock
description: Calls a library routine through the dos base and stores a non-zero result through the output pointer. Otherwise it calls the library's unlock routine, and it returns true when the result is zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7C4A
name: store_value_return_zero
description: Stores the value in a register through a pointer and returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7C50
name: open_file_handle_store
description: Calls the dos library's Open entry through the library base, stores a non-zero handle through the output pointer, and returns true when the result is zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7C66
name: store_long_through_pointer
description: Writes a 32-bit value from a data register through an address register pointer and returns zero. It has no library calls and is reached from four unnamed routines.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7C70
name: close_file_and_zero_block
description: Closes the file handle held in the structure through the dos library when the handle is non-zero, otherwise repeats the check on the global state block. It then clears 144 bytes starting at the structure, and the surrounding text reports a closing error for an already closed handle.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7C88
name: close_file_zero_block_direct
description: Closes the file handle through the dos library's Close entry, then clears 144 bytes starting at the structure. It is called by one unnamed routine and has no branch for an empty handle.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7CAA
name: read_when_count_positive
description: Returns zero without reading when the requested byte count is not positive. Otherwise it calls the dos library's Read entry with the caller's arguments and returns that result.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7CC2
name: forward_dos_read
description: Calls the dos library's Read entry through the library base with the caller's arguments and returns nothing. It is called from one unnamed routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7D28
name: forward_dos_write
description: Calls the dos library's Write entry through the library base, passing the caller's arguments on, and returns nothing. It is called from one unnamed routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:7FB0
name: store_standard_handles
description: Stores the result of the dos Input call in the state block. It also stores the result of the dos Output call there, unless a state flag is set, in which case it stores zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:809E
name: call_dos_792_if_clear
description: Calls a dos library entry at offset -792 only when a state byte is zero. It is entered through a handler pointer and from one unnamed routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:80C0
name: cleanup_after_user_abort
description: Calls two helper routines in turn, the second one with the global state block. The text "User aborted" appears among the referenced strings of the surrounding archive code, which points to an abort path.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:80D0
name: apply_mode_five_set_flag
description: When a state byte is zero, calls a helper with the global block and the value 5, then sets a companion flag byte to one.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:80EC
name: apply_mode_four_clear_flag
description: When a state byte is zero, calls a helper with the global block and the value 4, then sets a companion flag byte to zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8106
name: write_when_output_enabled
description: Calls the dos Write entry only when a state flag is clear and the stored output handle is non-zero. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8134
name: write_output_in_blocks
description: Writes the requested count to the output handle in pieces of at most 1024 bytes. It checks a helper between pieces and returns 11 if that helper reports an error, otherwise it returns zero.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8158
name: write_remaining_in_chunks
description: Writes the remaining byte count through the dos Write entry in pieces of at most 1024 bytes. A checking helper runs between pieces, and an error from it makes the routine return 11.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:8164
name: write_chunks_until_exhausted
description: Writes data in pieces of at most 1024 bytes until no bytes remain, returning zero on completion. A helper runs between pieces, and an error from it makes the routine return 11.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:818C
name: format_string_and_write
description: When output is enabled and the output handle is set, formats a line into a buffer in the state block, measures its length by scanning to the terminator, then writes it with the dos Write entry.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:81CE
name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately; it is an empty entry reached from one unnamed routine.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:81D0
name: call_dos_426_if_clear
description: Calls the dos library entry at offset -426 only when a state byte is zero. The routine is entered from one unnamed caller.

key: gloom - special edition 97 (1997)(black magic)(disk 1 of 3)[hd]/Gloom - Special Edition 97 (1997)(Black Magic)(Disk 1 of 3)[HD].adf:LZX:0:81EE
name: call_dos_426_copy
description: Calls the dos library entry at offset -426 only when a state byte is zero. It is a second copy of the same gated call, reached from one unnamed caller.
